history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man with dark, tousled hair stands beside a sleek, light grey Vespa scooter. He is wearing a black long-sleeved shirt with an intricate, detailed pattern of a mythical creature, possibly a dragon or phoenix, in earthy tones of brown, white, and gold. His gaze is directed away from the camera, towards the right side of the frame, with his right hand resting on the scooter's seat.

The scooter is the primary focus, its metallic grey paint reflecting the dappled sunlight filtering through unseen trees. Key features of the scooter are visible: the black leather seat, the chrome handlebars and mirrors, the distinctive Vespa emblem on the front, and the clear turn signals. The front fender has a sporty detail with three horizontal red accents. The scooter appears to be parked on an asphalt road, with a concrete curb and sidewalk running along the left side of the image.

The background is somewhat out of focus, showing a textured concrete sidewalk with visible joints and a drain grate. Scattered dry leaves lie on the asphalt and sidewalk, suggesting an outdoor, possibly autumnal setting. The lighting is natural, with strong sunlight creating distinct patches of light and shadow on the ground and illuminating the scooter's surfaces. The overall color palette is muted, dominated by the grey of the scooter, the dark tones of the man's shirt and the asphalt, and the neutral greys and browns of the background. The mood is calm and contemplative, with a touch of modern style conveyed by the scooter and the man's attire. The image has a slightly elevated, top-down perspective.
